primitive_shape_language.hair: large irregular compact mass above and behind the head
primitive_shape_language.guard: raised diagonal arm blocks around face and chest
primitive_shape_language.lower_body: broad indigo trouser masses tapering toward wrapped feet
primitive_shape_language.asymmetry: teal sash mass hangs on screen-right

proportion_matrix.head_and_hair: identity-dominant but subordinate to full body height

line_weight_policy.inner_lines: one logical pixel only where material or joint separation requires it

shading_model.skin_and_orange: warm highlights with dark red-brown shadows
shading_model.micro_motion: internal palette-cluster motion only; external silhouette remains locked for idle

extreme_pose_limits.idle: no external scale change, no foot displacement, no head redesign
extreme_pose_limits.future_attacks: may exceed idle envelope only under a dedicated action contract
